mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 75 degree temperatures with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library and a moderate air quality index of 54.

The City of Verona continues its partnership with AECOM for ongoing engineering services, with detailed reports presented regularly to the City Council, and the Senior Center is currently offering free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail for those who sign up in advance.
Today features live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, while tomorrow you can check out the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol or live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a report from July 28, Verona police conducted a check at Fireman's Park after closing hours, resulting in a warning for two individuals and an arrest of a man with an outstanding warrant.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for the Really Reese's flavor before closing time at 10:30 PM, and you can also find Kona Ice at Fireman's Park today from 11 AM until 4 PM.
